description: Intake — auto-flagged weekly trend metrics for a marketplace/week from os_ads_performance_trend_analysis_report: metric name, old value, new value, change percent, severity, and primary_reason. Row-level passthrough (one row per flagged metric, no aggregation); scoped to one Sunday-Saturday week via the date range and to one marketplace via a marketplace_client_id filter. Python flags rows where severity != 'normal' and derives the prior-week baseline.

metric.description: The trend metric that was flagged (e.g. roas, cpc, ctr, budget_utilisation, response_rate).

old_value.description: The metric's value in the prior/baseline week.

new_value.description: The metric's value in the reported week.

change_perc.description: Percent change of the metric from old_value to new_value (raw source column from the trend-analysis report).

severity.description: Flag severity for this metric (e.g. normal / warning / critical); Python flags rows where severity != 'normal'.

primary_reason.description: Primary reason attributed to the metric change.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_ads_performance_trend_analysis_report` AS tr WHERE DATE(tr.start_date) = '__START_DATE_1__' AND DATE(tr.end_date) = '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
